comments.author: BIakeC
comments.body:
If you've already gotten the Millionaire job, and want to get the card again, this is the quest you take:

"Trade expansion plan" 8 star quest at the St. Petersburg Merchants' Guild. It says it needs Greek language but you should be able to pull it without it, as I have done. You must delivery 50 Fine Tribute Goods (Large Ships) to the Merchant GM in Athens. A daunting task considering the amount of materials your need to make 50 of those. Fortunately, there's no time limit so you can take all the time you need.

If you have Tycoon unlocked, you've already finished the St. Petersburg/Sophie chain for Millionaire. As BlakeC said, to get another Millionaire job card, do this quest: Trade expansion plan
